message: 境

Patrols are ramped up with the Holy Night Festival right around the corner. I've come to the Culture Hall. Precisely because it's a place I rarely visit, I have to check thoroughly to make sure no Demons are lurking around!

name: Misasagi
message: 「Good day to you, Mr. President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ohoho. I was just indulging in a tiny bit of mischief, you see. I was thinking of scribbling my name on a chair to leave my mark.」

name: Synn
message: 「G-Misasagi-senpai, doing something like that...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「I only jotted it down a little toward the bottom as a keepsake so nobody would spot it. After all, the Culture Hall is a place near and dear to me.」

name: Synn
message: 「T-This place is?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why, yes, it is?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Ah... haha. Don't tell me you've never set foot in here aside from morning assemblies and student general meetings, Mr. President?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, isn't that normal--」

name: Misasagi
message: 「You know how the library is open to the public on weekends? Just like that, the Culture Hall is also used for concerts and recitals by students and townsfolk alike.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-Is that so.」
...Is it just my imagination? Does she seem to be talking more cheerfully than usual?

name: Misasagi
message: 「Indeed. And the seat I always have the pleasure of sitting in is right over there--the very spot where I was crouching just now.」
Misasagi-senpai uses her folding fan like a pointer to show me which seat it is.

name: Synn
message: 「Hm?」
Suddenly, a shadow of melancholy crosses Misasagi-senpai's gaze.
Aside from the two of us, the auditorium is completely empty.

name: Synn
message: 「Misasagi―senpai, um―」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Come to think of it, Mr. President? A young girl named Sally-chan often drops by the Wagashi Club to eat sweets, does she not?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「That child isn't human--she's from some other clan, isn't she?」

name: Synn
message: 「U-Ummm... If I remember right, I think she's from the Taichute clan...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「A Demon.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There's no need to hide it. Isn't Ryuusei Town just that sort of place? Why, just the other day, a friend of Sally-chan's came to the tasting event as well.」

name: Synn
message: 「Y-You're awfully calm about this, Senpai. Why do you think that way?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「As a matter of fact, Asukai Shrine may have wards for sealing centipedes, but they don't have any for sealing demons, do they?」

name: Synn
message: 「That's true...」

name: Synn
message: 「...Misasagi-senpai, what do you think of me?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, President, aren't you a fine young man?」

name: Synn
message: 「Ba-thump!?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「To me, anyone who doesn't just spout empty flattery is a good kid.」

name: Synn
message: 「W-What, that's all...」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Why are you looking so down? Having that kind of disposition is a difficult thing, you know.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Isn't it precisely because you're that kind of president that Sally-chan is staying in this town?」

name: Misasagi
message: 「There are some members in the Wagashi Club who feel uneasy about demons, too... though it's really just like how people viewed foreigners back when the country first opened its borders.」

name: Synn
message: 「I-I seeee!! Yeah, yeah, totally!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You're nodding way too hard.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「So, what would you think about everyone singing Christmas songs together at the Holy Night Festival?」
The sudden shift to the Holy Night Festival leaves me a little bewildered.

name: Misasagi
message: 「I heard there's a self-proclaimed composer among Sally-chan's friends.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「Since entering Ryuusei Academy, I've gotten to listen to all kinds of performances here, and music knows no borders.」

name: Misasagi
message: 「If we sing and dance together with the demons at the Holy Night Festival, don't you think that prejudice might just fade away?」

name: Synn
message: 「T-That's a great idea--super great!」

In Misasagi-senpai's heart, the culture hall, Sally-chan... the demons, and the Holy Night Festival all stand cleanly on equal footing. I feel ashamed of myself for doubting that, even for a split second.

name: Misasagi
message: 「Well, I haven't come up with any concrete details yet, though.」

name: Synn
message: 「No, you've clearly been thinking this through, Misasagi-senpai.」
I stay and talk with her for a while.
Parting ways with Misasagi-senpai, I step out of the culture hall. Naturally, the air is colder than inside the auditorium.
Looking up, the sky stretches high with thin wisps of cloud. The autumn breeze feels increasingly crisp and clear.
Perhaps thanks to being touched by Misasagi-senpai's sensibility, I found myself imagining something completely out of character.
